name: selfpage
description: Xinyang Zeng's Homepage - static Astro site and same-origin author tools

scripts.dev:author: npm run dev --workspace @selfpage/author
scripts.dev:author:github: npm run build --workspace @selfpage/author && cd apps/author && node ../../node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev --port 8787 --env-file ../../.dev.vars
scripts.check: npm run check:workflows && npm run check:worker && npm run check:runners && npm run check:root && npm run check:format && npm run check --workspace @selfpage/content-model && npm run check --workspace @selfpage/markdown && npm run check --workspace @selfpage/site-shell && npm run check --workspace @selfpage/site && npm run check --workspace @selfpage/author
scripts.test:e2e:author: node tests/run-author-e2e.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @selfpage/site && npm run build --workspace @selfpage/author
scripts.deploy:author: node tests/check-author-build-env.mjs && npm run check:worker && npm run build --workspace @selfpage/author && cd apps/author && node ../../node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy
